glance.summary: Pennsylvania signed a law requiring labels on advertisements significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence.
Apollo economist reported artificial intelligence has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech.
Bayer Crop Science launched a multi-agent decision engine allowing researchers to query their analytics platform.
r/opensource banned projects that use AI, are made by AI, or are intended for AI.

big_pour.headline: Pennsylvania requires labels on AI-generated advertisements
big_pour.summary: Pennsylvania passed a law requiring disclosures on still image, video, audio, or text ads that have been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence.
big_pour.why: You will know when advertisements you see, hear, or read were made or modified by artificial intelligence.

explain.kid: If someone makes an ad using artificial intelligence to create or change pictures, sounds, or words, a new rule says they must clearly put a label on it.
explain.pm: Pennsylvania now mandates standardized disclosure labels on any advertising text, image, audio, or video that has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence.
explain.engineer: A new Pennsylvania law mandates that any text, audio, video, or image ad significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence must include a disclosure label in a matching format.

big_pour.headline: Apollo economist reports zero financial payoff from AI
big_pour.summary: Despite massive investments and widespread hype, artificial intelligence has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech, according to an Apollo economist.

big_pour.headline: Blue Planet III leaves rough edges against AI
big_pour.summary: BBC's Blue Planet III is keeping less-than-perfect shots to prove authenticity, avoiding the overly polished look typical of artificial intelligence.

office_blend.headline: Bayer Crop Science builds agentic analytics platform
office_blend.summary: Bayer Crop Science built the Agentic Decision Engine on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, allowing researchers, breeders, and analysts to ask natural language questions about their analytics platform.

office_blend.headline: IskayPet unifies corporate knowledge with Amazon Bedrock
office_blend.summary: Pet care company IskayPet built a multilingual assistant answering employee questions across four languages and three countries without managing retrieval infrastructure.

still_roasting.summary: Anthropic is offering its Claude Duet agent app through a waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

quick_sips.summary: r/opensource banned submissions that use AI, are made by AI, or are intended for AI.
SAP added AI-powered roleplays to its annual certification renewal process to evaluate how professionals apply their knowledge.
Amazon Polly upgraded its Generative engine with lower latency, more expressive speech, and 14 new voices across 9 locales.

stories.label: Open standard
stories.headline: OpenAI donates Open Responses specification to foundation
stories.summary: OpenAI announced it is donating the Open Responses API specification for common language model APIs to the open source Agentic AI Foundation.

stories.label: New tool
stories.headline: Google open-sources native PyTorch stack for TPUs
stories.summary: Google open-sourced TorchTPU at PyTorch Conference North America 2026, offering a native PyTorch stack for Google TPUs.

concept.explanation: TorchTPU is a native PyTorch stack for Google TPUs that Google open-sourced at PyTorch Conference North America 2026 to open paths beyond Nvidia.

long_read.headline: What’s the ROI of software engineers’ spending on AI?
long_read.summary: The newsletter analyzes data from 27 companies to investigate whether increased spending on AI by software engineers has actually improved shipping velocity and pull request output.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: Using one model to grade another model's output against a rubric, so quality can be scored at scale without a human reading every answer.
word.heard: "We use LLM-as-a-judge for faithfulness, calibrated against 50 human labels."
word.analogy: Like a head barista taste-testing every cup, after you've checked their palate agrees with yours.

keep_brewing.name: AI For Everyone
keep_brewing.description: Andrew Ng's short, non-technical course on what AI can and can't do at work.

poll.question: Do you use an AI chatbot at work at least once a week?
